title: The Anvil-Right of Orsinium
summary: Prevent a blood-feud between the iron-clans of Orsinium and the old-faith strongholds when clanless raiders steal the Paragon's Hammer-Roll from Merchant's Gate.

npcs.name: Forge-Wife Ghorakha
npcs.greet: Hold your step by the slag-trough, outlander! If you bring ore-writs from the lowlands, the High Forge is barred until the Blood-Price is settled.
talk: Last night clanless raiders struck Merchant's Gate and stole the bronze Hammer-Roll that partitions the orichalcum seams between Orsinium and Morkul Stronghold.
Chief Bazrag's hotheads blame Morkul's Malacath-sworn smiths, while Morkul blames the Trinimac priests in Orsinium. Meet Hearth-Wife Ulga at Morkul Stronghold before axes are drawn.

npcs.name: Hearth-Wife Ulga
npcs.greet: Let the city-Orcs polish their white stone! Morkul's anvils were ringing before Orsinium was rebuilt—and we do not steal in the dark.
talk: The raiders left broken Trinimac emblems at Merchant's Gate to frame Orsinium, and Malacath ash-fetishes on Morkul's road to frame us.
That is the work of Skargol the Clanless and the Daughters of Wroth in Frostbreak Fortress and Watcher's Hold.

npcs.name: Outrider Agharz
npcs.greet: You ride fast for a lowlander! My scouts tracked the clanless pack-mules across Morkul Plain toward Watcher's Hold.
talk: Hag-Matron Kraugha of the Daughters of Wroth holds half the stolen Hammer-Roll in Watcher's Hold, while Skargol took the other half to Frostbreak Fortress.
Slay Kraugha first, or her ice-storms will close the pass to Frostbreak.

npcs.name: Shield-Thane Broguk
npcs.greet: By Mauloch's tusk, you broke through Kraugha's wind-ward! Skargol's warband is inside the inner keep of Frostbreak Fortress.
talk: Skargol plans to melt the bronze Hammer-Roll in the siege-furnace so every stronghold in Wrothgar goes to war over the mines.
Come—let us crack his shield-wall together!

story_wg_merchants_gate: Forge-Wife Ghorakha: Look at the stone lintel of Merchant's Gate—chiseled out where the bronze Hammer-Roll hung for sixty winters.
Outrider Agharz: And see the boot-prints in the slag? Unshod mountain-ponies, driven north toward Morkul Plain.
Forge-Wife Ghorakha: Go to Morkul Stronghold and show Hearth-Wife Ulga this broken rivet before her sons march on the gate.
story_wg_watchers_hold: Hag-Matron Kraugha: Let the fat smiths of Orsinium and the proud chiefs of Morkul split each other's skulls over the ore-veins!
Outrider Agharz: The Daughters of Wroth will choke on their own frost, witch!
Hag-Matron Kraugha: Hear the peaks howl, iron-bound sheep!
story_wg_frostbreak_furnace: Skargol the Clanless: When the Hammer-Roll runs as molten brass in this trough, no chief will own the mountain's ribs!
Shield-Thane Broguk: The Code is carved in blood and memory, Skargol, not just bronze!
Skargol the Clanless: Then come and write your name in my axe!

quests.title: The Empty Lintel at Merchant's Gate
quests.summary: Inspect the theft at Merchant's Gate with Forge-Wife Ghorakha and carry proof of the ambush to Hearth-Wife Ulga at Morkul Stronghold.
intro: The bronze Hammer-Roll that governs ore-rights across Wrothgar has been pried from Merchant's Gate, bringing Orsinium and the strongholds to the brink of war.
Examine the gate at Merchant's Gate and travel to Morkul Stronghold to parley with Hearth-Wife Ulga.
complete: Hearth-Wife Ulga recognized the false tokens left by Skargol the Clanless and the Daughters of Wroth.

journal.start: Forge-Wife Ghorakha in Orsinium asked me to inspect Merchant's Gate and speak with Hearth-Wife Ulga at Morkul Stronghold.
journal.done: Hearth-Wife Ulga agreed to stay Morkul's blades while I hunt Skargol the Clanless.

quests.title: Hoofprints on Morkul Plain
quests.summary: Track the clanless raiders past Paragon's Remembrance and meet Outrider Agharz at Fharun Stronghold.
intro: The clanless pack-train crossed Morkul Plain past Paragon's Remembrance toward the northern crags.
Search Paragon's Remembrance for the raiders' trail and confer with Outrider Agharz at Fharun Stronghold.
complete: Outrider Agharz located Hag-Matron Kraugha's coven inside Watcher's Hold.

journal.start: I must follow the raiders' trail past Paragon's Remembrance to Outrider Agharz at Fharun Stronghold.
journal.done: Outrider Agharz confirmed that the Hammer-Roll was split between Watcher's Hold and Frostbreak Fortress.

quests.title: The Witch-Wind of Watcher's Hold
quests.summary: Storm Watcher's Hold, slay Hag-Matron Kraugha, and recover the first half of the bronze Hammer-Roll.
intro: Hag-Matron Kraugha of the Daughters of Wroth holds the upper towers of Watcher's Hold, calling down blizzards to shield Skargol's retreat.
Fight through Watcher's Hold and defeat Hag-Matron Kraugha.
complete: With Kraugha slain, the blizzard over the northern ridge cleared, opening the road to Frostbreak Fortress.

journal.start: I must assault Watcher's Hold and defeat Hag-Matron Kraugha.
journal.done: I slew Hag-Matron Kraugha in Watcher's Hold and recovered the first half of the Hammer-Roll.

quests.title: Iron and Recognition
quests.summary: Join Shield-Thane Broguk at Frostbreak Fortress, defeat Skargol the Clanless, and restore the Hammer-Roll to Orsinium.
intro: Skargol the Clanless has lit the great siege-furnace in Frostbreak Fortress to melt the remaining bronze tablets of the Hammer-Roll.
Speak with Shield-Thane Broguk, defeat Skargol, and carry the restored Hammer-Roll back to Forge-Wife Ghorakha in Orsinium.
complete: Skargol the Clanless fell before the furnace, and the reforged Hammer-Roll now hangs once more above the High Forge of Orsinium.

journal.start: I must join Shield-Thane Broguk at Frostbreak Fortress, defeat Skargol the Clanless, and return the Hammer-Roll to Orsinium.
journal.done: I defeated Skargol the Clanless and restored the Hammer-Roll to Forge-Wife Ghorakha in Orsinium, earning Gortwog's Hammer.
